title: Reversal of Paid Pharmacy Claims (Network Pharmacy Manual)
content:
**Claims clause, Pharmacy Benefit.** A pharmacy may reverse a paid fill identified by its prescription number and fill date, and the reversal returns the fill's copay and removes the fill from the monthly count. A reversal is accepted no later than the plan's reversal window days after the original fill date. The reversal days are counted in calendar days from the day after the fill date, and a reversal on the last day still qualifies. A fill is reversed at most once.

### Time basis

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Event the clock starts from | The original fill date of the paid fill |
| Verifiable record | The paid fill on the member's claims, matched by its prescription number and fill date |
| Unit | Calendar days |
| Day 1 | The day after the fill date |
| Comparison | The reversal date is not later than the last day of the window |
| The last day itself | Qualifies |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical, window of 90 days)

Fill date 1 March 2026. Day 1 is 2 March; 31 March is day 30; 30 April is day 60; 30 May is day 90.

| Reversal date | Day of the window | Accepted |
|---|---|---|
| 30 May 2026 | 90 — the last day | Yes |
| 31 May 2026 | 91 | No |

### Effects of an accepted reversal

- the member's copay on that fill is returned in full;
- the fill no longer counts toward the monthly count;
- the same fill cannot be reversed a second time.
